aarti.tek: Perform the āratī of the youthful pair. Rādhe! Offer up your wealth for them.
aarti.pad1: The beauty of their faces is that of millions of suns and moons; seeing it, my heart is enticed. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Gazing at the fair face and the dark, the heart is enraptured; drink in the Lord's form with your eyes to the full. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: A platter of gold and a wick of camphor; Hari has come, and the heart has become pure. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: A bed of flowers, a garland of flowers; Nanda's darling sits on a jewelled throne. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: The peacock crown and the flute in his hand look lovely; seeing him dressed as the finest of dancers, the heart is enchanted. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Half is clad in a blue sari, half in a yellow robe: this is Kuñjabihārī, the holder of the great mountain. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Śrī Puruṣottama, the holder of the great mountain: all the women of Vraja perform his āratī. ॥7॥
aarti.pad8: Nanda's darling and Vṛṣabhānu's young daughter, the lords of Paramānanda, are an unshakeable pair. ॥8॥
